summary.name: HeyGen
summary.one_liner: HeyGen is an AI video platform that generates videos from text scripts, images, audio, and personal avatars, with tools for avatar creation, voice cloning, and video translation.
keywords: make talking head video with ai
use_cases: Creating explainer and product demo videos from a script
Turning slides or PDFs into narrated presenter videos
Translating and lip-syncing existing videos into other languages
Producing talking-avatar videos for training or marketing
Converting podcasts or audio files into video with avatars and subtitles
Making short social media clips without filming
summary.what_it_does: HeyGen generates AI videos featuring avatars, including a Personal Avatar option built from the user's own face and voice, with claimed consistency across angles and expressions. Its text-based AI Studio editor lets users control tone, gestures, emotion and pacing from a script, with captions, Brand Kit, and multi-user collaboration. Video Agent creates videos from a prompt, with editable motion graphics and presenter footage. Video Translation translates uploaded files or YouTube links with voice cloning and lip-sync across 175+ languages and dialects. Separate tools convert images, audio, PPT/PDF decks, and text into videos.
notable: Avatar V personal avatar that keeps one consistent identity across shots and languages
Text-based AI Studio editor where a script drives delivery, gestures and emotion
Video translation with voice cloning and lip-sync in 175+ languages
Requires on-camera identity verification before a custom avatar is created
caveats: Paid plans unlock advanced features, editor options and more formats; the free plan covers text-to-video and AI video creation
Custom avatars require on-camera identity verification from the person depicted
Page claims are marketing statements; no independent pricing details are given on the page
